en.title: Capture knowledge in Notion
en.description: Turn notes and conversations into linked wiki pages, decisions, or FAQs.
tasks: Turn notes and conversations into linked wiki pages, decisions, or FAQs.
prerequisites: A connected Notion MCP integration with access to the target pages and databases.
en.example: Use notion-knowledge-capture. Turn these meeting notes into a decision page with owners, dates, and links to supporting pages.
en.expectedResult: A structured Notion draft with source links and the target database properties.
limitations: The ZIP does not install the Notion connector; creating pages changes your workspace.
Upstream Codex connector setup commands are version-specific; use your current host’s Notion connection settings.

zh.title: 整理 Notion 知识库
zh.description: 将笔记与对话整理为带关联的知识页、决策或 FAQ。
tasks: 将笔记与对话整理为带关联的知识页、决策或 FAQ。
prerequisites: 已连接 Notion MCP，且可访问目标页面与数据库。
zh.example: 请使用 notion-knowledge-capture：把这些会议笔记整理为决策页，列明负责人、日期及依据页面链接。
zh.expectedResult: 结构化 Notion 草稿、来源链接和目标数据库属性。
limitations: ZIP 不会安装 Notion 连接器；创建页面会修改工作区。
上游 Codex 连接配置命令有版本差异，请使用当前宿主的 Notion 连接设置。
